text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: The ocean breeze feels so pleasant...
text_block_list.orig_text: 潮風が心地よいですね……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Spending the summer days like this with you
brings me insurmountable joy, my lord.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして主さまと共に夏を過ごすことができ、
わたくしは本当に幸せでございます。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
I can only hope that we're able to see this
same scenery once again. Not just next year, but in the years that follow as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
来年も、
再来年も、
ずっとずーっと、
主さまとこうして海を眺めたいです。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: To that extent, my lord... I look forward to being always by your side. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
主さま……
これからもどうぞ、
末永く、
よろしくお願い致します♪
